basic.name: Corkage Fee
basic.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gallagher's ATK to a single target enemy.

variants.name: Nectar Blitz
variants.description_template: Deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gallagher's ATK to a single target enemy. Reduces the target's ATK by {{scaling2}}%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

skill.name: Special Brew
skill.description_template: Immediately heals a target ally for {{scaling1}} HP.

ultimate.name: Champagne Etiquette
ultimate.description_template: Inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s). At the same time, deals Fire DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies, and enhances his next Basic ATK to Nectar Blitz.

talent.name: Tipsy Tussle
talent.description_template: The Besotted state makes targets receive {{scaling1}}% more Break DMG. Every time a Besotted target gets attacked by an ally, the attacking ally's HP is restored by {{scaling2}}.

technique.name: Artisan Elixir
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, inflicts Besotted on all enemies, lasting for 2 turn(s). And deals Fire DMG equal to 50% of Gallagher's ATK to all enemies.

2.name: Novel Concoction
2.description: Increases this unit's Outgoing Healing by an amount equal to 50% of Break Effect, up to a maximum Outgoing Healing increase of 75%.

4.name: Organic Yeast
4.description: After using the Ultimate, immediately advances action for this unit by 100%.

6.name: Bottoms Up
6.description: When Gallagher uses Nectar Blitz to attack Besotted enemies, the HP Restore effect of his Talent will also apply to teammates for this time.

eidolons.name: Salty Dog
eidolons.description: When entering the battle, Gallagher regenerates 20 Energy and increases Effect RES by 50%.

eidolons.name: Lion's Tail
eidolons.description: When using the Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from the designated ally. At the same time, increases their Effect RES by 30% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Corpse Reviver
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Last Word
eidolons.description: Extends the duration of the Besotted state inflicted by Gallagher's Ultimate by 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Death in the Afternoon
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Blood and Sand
eidolons.description: Increases Gallagher's Break Effect by 20% and Weakness Break Efficiency by 20%.
